billing_refunds: Charges, double charges, refunds already promised, invoices, promo codes or discounts not applied, unexplained charges on a statement.
order_shipping: Where an order is, tracking, delivery dates, changing a delivery address, shipping upgrades, partial or missing deliveries.
returns_exchanges: Returning an item, return labels, exchanges for another size or color, return windows, status of a return already sent back.
tech_login: Login or password problems, reset emails, two-step verification, app or website errors and crashes, checkout errors.
account_changes: Updating profile details such as email or phone number, merging accounts, communication or marketing preferences.
fraud_security: Orders or changes the customer did not make, someone else in their account, phishing or scam reports, stolen payment details.
product_questions: Questions about a product's size, features, compatibility, care instructions or stock availability.
complaints_escalation: The customer is unhappy with service or repeated failures, reports a rude agent, damaged items, or asks for a manager.
cancellations: Cancelling an order, a subscription or membership, turning off auto-renew, or closing an account.
legal_privacy: Data deletion or data access requests (GDPR, CCPA), legal threats, lawyers, or regulatory complaints.
other: Anything else: greetings only, cut-off or empty messages, off-topic questions, business or partnership inquiries.
